h1: NovoTech fiber laser cutters — open, enclosed exchange-table and sheet + tube lasers, 1.5 to 60 kW · value line
intro: These are NovoTech's own fiber lasers — the value line: built in China to our specification with Raycus, MAX or IPG sources, Raytools, BOCI or Precitec heads, Cypcut controls, Hiwin guides and Schneider electrics, inspected before they ship and sold under NovoTech's name. Four families on one page: the open-type ULF single-table lasers — the G build from 1.5 to 6 kW, the heavier E build to 12 kW and large-format plate tables from 20 × 8.5 to 85 × 10.5 ft with up to 60 kW; the enclosed ULE with an exchange table that swaps in 15 seconds, from 10 × 5 to 41 × 8.5 ft and 3 to 40 kW; and the ULFT and ULET, which cut sheet and tube to Ø13.8″ on one machine, open or enclosed. For the Turkish-built premium lasers see the Dener page; for 4 × 4 ft compact machines, 80 kW and coil-fed lines see Senfeng. Every machine is installed and supported from Mississauga, ON, with a CSA-approved panel and a 1-year warranty.

groups.title: NovoTech fiber lasers — the value line
groups.lead: Open single-table, enclosed exchange-table and sheet + tube lasers from 10 × 5 to 85 × 10.5 ft, 1.5 to 60 kW.

faq.a: The ULF is the open machine: a single table loaded from three sides, the lowest price per kilowatt and the right choice for a shop that cuts a few hours a day and unloads by hand. The ULE puts the cutting area in a full enclosure — laser-safe windows, fumes extracted from inside the cabin, less noise — and adds an exchange table that swaps in 15 seconds, so the laser cuts while the operator loads the next sheet. Above 6 kW, for two shifts, or with a storage tower in mind, buy the ULE.

Both are open single-table lasers. The G build takes 1.5 to 6 kW and moves at 295 ft/min with 1.4 G — plenty for sheet and light plate. The E build has a heavier frame for 1.5 to 12 kW, 459 ft/min and 1.7 G, a 7.2 ft wide table option (4022E, 6022E) and higher table loads; the large-format E machines from 20 × 8.5 to 85 × 10.5 ft take 6 to 60 kW for plate. Choose the E if you plan to go above 6 kW later or cut thick plate every day.

faq.q: What thickness does each laser power cut?
faq.a: As a guide for mild steel cut with oxygen: 3 kW cuts to 3/4″ (20 mm), 6 kW to 1″ (25 mm), 12 kW to 1-3/16″ (30 mm), and 20 to 30 kW to 2 – 2-3/8″ (50 – 60 mm). The production thickness — where the edge is clean and the speed pays — is about two-thirds of the maximum, and stainless and aluminum cut with nitrogen run thinner at the same power. Most Canadian job shops buying today choose 6 or 12 kW; we send the cutting-speed chart for your material with the quote.

faq.q: Sheet and tube on one machine — ULFT or ULET?
faq.a: Both add a pneumatic rotary chuck and tube supports to the sheet laser: round, square and rectangular tube to Ø8.7″ or Ø13.8″ and 20, 29.5 or 39 ft long, cut with the same source and head. The ULFT is the open version on the ULF table, to 85 × 10.5 ft and 60 kW; the ULET is the enclosed version with the exchange table, to 41 × 8.5 ft and 40 kW. A shop that cuts tube every day is better served by a dedicated ULT tube laser with a loader.

faq.q: What does the laser need on site?
faq.a: Three-phase power (600 V with the CSA panel, or 208 / 240 / 480 V on request), compressed air at 185 psi (13 bar) and 53 cfm (1.5 m³/min) for air cutting, oxygen and nitrogen of 99.96 % purity, a dust collector, and a shop between 41 and 86 °F (5 – 30 °C) with humidity under 70 % — the water chiller is included. We lay the machine out for your building and size the compressor and dust collector with the quote.

faq.q: How does the NovoTech value line compare with Dener and Senfeng?
faq.a: Dener is the premium line: built in Turkey with Precitec heads, IPG or nLIGHT sources and Dener Canada parts in Mississauga, for the shop that cuts two shifts a day for twenty years. Senfeng is a value line sold under its own brand, with the widest range — 4 × 4 ft compact machines, 80 kW, 3D and coil-fed lasers. The NovoTech lasers are our own brand, built in China to our specification with Raycus or IPG sources, Cypcut controls and Hiwin, YYC and Schneider components, at the lowest price of the three; all are installed, warranted and serviced by the same NovoTech technicians. We quote all three so you can compare.

faq.q: What voltage do these machines run on?
faq.a: Three-phase machines are supplied for 600 V as standard with a CSA-approved panel; 208 V, 240 V and 480 V 3-phase are available on request, and 240 V single-phase on models with a small enough motor. Manual machines have no electrics.
